title: Long-tail learning via logit adjustment
mechanism: Add tau*log(class prior) to logits inside the CE during training (or subtract post hoc), a Fisher-consistent loss for balanced error.
adaptation: Priors from train pixel frequencies over the 17 present classes; apply to the CE term only, keep crack + inactive Dice. tau in {0.5, 1.0}. Watch crack width (prior 0.19%) and re-tune the crack bias after.
min_experiment: Arm: LA-CE tau 0.5 and 1.0, 3 seeds each; baseline SUP100 5 seeds; metric mIoU_rob plus splice/gridline/edge_dark IoU on OOF folds then test once; kill if mIoU_rob < +0.01 or crack IoU drop > 0.01 after crack bias re-tune.
evidence: R: classification long-tail benchmarks (CIFAR-LT, ImageNet-LT, iNaturalist); BLV paper also uses it as a fully supervised segmentation baseline.
prior_overlap: none for training-time LA; only post-hoc crack bias exists.
